verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents inviting AI agents directly into projects and offers official MCP support for ChatGPT, Claude and other agents, plus a CLI and Skills. Agents can therefore work inside the same shared project record (threaded posts, to-dos with attachments) as people and other tools, which preserves context in one place. However, there is no documented handoff mechanism or guarantee that context transfers between agents or tools. Missing for 10: an explicit agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff feature, documentation of context preservation across handoffs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information
